items.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut told ANI on Tuesday that the SC registry's 14 defects in the INDIA-bloc SIR writ petition (Rs 220 fee shortfall, missing vakalatnamas, Kharge ID copy) are real and 'will be rectified and repaired'; he confirmed he is a petitioner and that all parties in Monday's march are petitioners. He said the bloc will stay in Delhi until the future direction is decided after Rahul Gandhi's 4 PM IST high tea, attacked PM Modi and HM Amit Shah for 'choking democracy' by restricting Jantar Mantar, and hinted at a Krishna Menon Road action: 'Tomorrow, we will do it at Krishna Menon Road as well.'
items.title: Sanjay Raut: petition defects will be 'rectified and repaired'; strategy after Rahul's 4 PM high tea

items.event_time_ist: Oct 13 (Tuesday morning; posted after the alerted Tiranga/reclaim post burst)
items.summary: New image post on the official @cockroachjantaparty handle (~130K likes): 'We are not going to bow down to your dictatorial orders! Jai Hind!' Shortcode newer than the already-alerted 10:46-11:19 AM IST Tiranga/reclaim/denotify post burst; pure defiance rhetoric, no new facts.
items.title: Official CJP post: 'We are not going to bow down to your dictatorial orders! Jai Hind!'
